players.product: AI data-center colocation (Tydal, Norway: 121 IT MW leased to Volta for NVIDIA GPUs) and Bitdeer AI GPU cloud (NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 / Vera Rubin capacity in Malaysia, Norway and the US)

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 results release, operational summary (three months ended June 30, 2026 vs 2025): total hash rate under management 86.1 EH/s (30.6); co-mining hash rate in third-party datacenters 15.9 EH/s on 56,000 co-mining rigs (none a year earlier); total mining rigs under management 289,000 (200,000); BTC held 150 (1,502); total power usage 2,537,000 MWh (1,180,000); average cost of electricity $44/MWh ($43); average miner efficiency 15.8 J/TH (25.7). Sales of SEALMINERs and accessories were US$0.4 million vs US$69.5 million. Inventories decreased from US$252.0 million to nil as inventories (primarily wafers, chips, WIP and finished SEALMINERs) designated for self-mining and co-mining were reclassified to property, plant and equipment for the company's own use. Pipeline updates as of July 31, 2026: reconstruction of the two fire-damaged Massillon, Ohio buildings (26 MW) is underway and expected to be rebuilt and energized by the end of Q3 2026; the Weathersfield, Ohio site (formerly referred to as Niles) includes 41.8 acres of owned land and a transmission line extension agreement with a local utility company.
